additional_info.subject: RE: ID0435372-DC/Si-D/DK- Y2 / S3 300000007014] Update to FW4 CRM:02919000100
additional_info.body:
Yes it will be updated all the way to FW7.
However, there is a issue updating from FW3 to FW4.
When starting the update from SCB it do not DL FW4, so someone needs to SSH into the charger and fix something.
This happens to all charger updating from FW3 to FW4.
If you can get the FW4 downloaded and ready for installation, I will update the newer versions.
